artworks.title: A Study of Miranda for "The Tempest"
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a person seen from behind, looking upwards with their arms raised. They wear a long flowing garment. The background is a gradient from dark to light shades.

artworks.title: The Infant Shakespeare Nursed by Comedy and Tragedy
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures huddled together. The drawing shows three figures in an embrace. The lines are fluid and free, capturing a moment of intimacy or solidarity. The figures are drawn with sweeping gestures, suggesting fabric folds or cloaks around them. The background is minimal, with only hints of lines and shapes, leaving the focus on the central composition of the figures.

artworks.title: Study for "The Deluge"
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures in dynamic poses. The sketch shows figures in motion or expressive poses amidst a lightly rendered background. The figures are broadly outlined with minimal detail, suggesting motion or an emotionally charged scene. They cluster in the foreground, with some figures leaning or crouching, while others have arms raised. Shading and lines are used to convey depth and form in a bustling or dramatic scene.

artworks.title: Tivoli
artworks.medium: graphite and watercolor on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows an ancient architectural site from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is behind the ruins, suggesting a vast landscape that extends beyond. A circular building with classical columns stands on the upper right. Other less distinct structures appear on the left, including one with an arched opening closer to us. Delicate pencil strokes and light watercolor washes create a subdued quality. The color palette consists of earthy tones and shades of sepia, blending with the paper’s natural color to give a timeless ambiance to the scene.

artworks.title: The Foot Bath (Drying Out)
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows four individuals. One person is seated on a low stool with one leg in a tub of water. He wears a nightcap and a loose shirt. To the left, a woman stands in front of a bed with a canopy. Another woman is seated on a stool washing clothes. On the far left, a third woman walks towards the group with a bowl and a pitcher. The background includes fabric drapes and simple wall lines, suggesting an interior room.

artworks.title: View from the Inn at Lynton
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with watercolor on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of a landscape with a coastline. The horizon is high in the image, with the sea meeting the sky. Cliffs are visible on the horizon. The painting has fine brushstrokes creating a soft and light scene. The color palette includes pastel tones like blues, greens, browns, and off-white. A road winds up a green slope past trees, houses, and a stone bridge. The road continues around a hill and disappears into the distance. A sailboat is seen in the water.

artworks.title: Ornamental Study with Acanthus Motif for "The Stones of Venice"
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with watercolor and graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of decorative leaf motifs. The image shows stylized leaf designs with careful attention to form and detail. The designs are laid out in panels, presenting variations of decorative leaf motifs. The leaves are depicted with precise lines and soft shading, using light blue accents to add depth. Notes and annotations in fine handwriting accompany the designs, suggesting they may be preliminary studies for architectural or decorative patterns.

artworks.title: Girl with a Bonnet at Work [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman bent over slightly at the waist, with her hands resting on the rim of a large basin in front of her. She has delicate facial features and her hair is styled neatly beneath a bonnet adorned with flowers. She wears a long dress with puffed sleeves and a gathered skirt. The setting appears minimal, focusing on the woman and the basin, with a plain background.

artworks.title: Girl with a Bonnet Reclining [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a figure seated comfortably on the floor in a relaxed pose. The person has their full body visible in profile, leaning on their left hand with their right arm on their lap and looking upwards. A brimmed hat partially obscures their face, with minimal facial details sketched. The person's curly hair escapes from under the hat. They wear a dress with a scalloped collar and three-quarter sleeves, spreading around them as they sit. Shoes are visible under the dress hem. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is plain with faint shading and lines.

artworks.title: A Hound Jumping
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a horse rearing. The sketch depicts the horse in mid-rear, with its body curved and front legs raised. It is drawn in a light pencil style against a plain background, emphasizing the outlines of the animal. The focus is on the horse's posture and anatomy, capturing a sense of fluidity and movement. The drawing aims to showcase the elegance and strength of the horse through a minimalist approach.

artworks.title: Huntsmen with Hounds and a Crouching Hare [recto]
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts animals and mounted figures in a landscape. The drawing features outlines of figures on horseback, a dog, and various other animals. The top section shows a figure on horseback moving alongside another animal. A large dog is drawn on the right side with a fluid line suggesting its stature. Below, there is a scene with multiple figures, some on horseback and others standing or interacting with animals on the ground. The strokes are light, providing a sense of motion and spontaneity.

artworks.title: Mounted Horsemen [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two sketchy figures on horseback. The drawing features two simplistic, linear sketches depicting figures on horseback. The left side displays a horse and rider seen from behind, positioned near some roughly indicated foliage. The right side shows another horse and rider, depicted in profile with the rider raising an arm. The horses are outlined with minimal lines. The bottom right section contains a hand-written note.

artworks.title: Study of Atlas
artworks.medium: graphite on tracing paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a dynamic pose, standing with a slightly bent posture, legs apart, and head bent downwards. There is an outlined large circle on the person's back, suggesting a heavy object. The sketch features well-defined muscles, bold lines, rough facial features, and simple hair lines. The figure is unclothed, and there are no visible items. The background is neutral with sketched outlines implying movement or multiple exposures of the same pose. The drawing is in dark pencil or charcoal on off-white paper.

artworks.title: Studies of Men and Women in Medieval Dress
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a pencil sketch drawing featuring various views and poses of individuals, primarily seen from the waist up or in three-quarter length. In the upper left corner, a person is shown standing wearing a long cloak with minimal facial details and a hood. Next to this, another figure walks towards the right in a long garment with their head turned slightly in profile. On the right side, a figure viewed from behind leans forward wearing a hat. Below, another character holds onto a cloak with their hand and has short hair, and beneath them is a person wearing a wide-brimmed hat. The background is plain, allowing focus on the outlined studies of the figures.

artworks.title: An Allegory of Britain's Mercantile Power
artworks.medium: pen and black and brown inks with gray wash over graphite, squared in graphite, on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical scene. It features multiple figures and symbolic elements that suggest a mythological or allegorical narrative. In the foreground, a seated figure draped in classical attire holds a shield with a flag motif and is accompanied by a reclining lion. To the right, standing figures dressed in flowing garments hold symbolic items. Above them, a winged figure with a trumpet hovers amidst clouds. In the background, there are softly sketched ships on water, and a dome-like structure on the horizon. The lines and shading convey an elegant composition consistent with classical themes.

artworks.title: An Allegory of Britain's Naval Might
artworks.medium: pen and black and brown inks with gray wash over graphite, squared in graphite, on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a classical mythological scene. On the left, a seated figure is observing the central scene, where a standing figure in robes and a helmet points to the right. Another similarly clad character observes nearby, and a lion stands boldly next to them. To the right, a floating figure extends an arm towards a background showing a fleet of ships at sea. Sea creatures or nymphs are visible in the foreground, adding movement to the scene. The composition is in delicate lines with subtle shadings.

artworks.title: King Solomon
artworks.medium: egg tempera (?) with touches of varnish on paper mounted to board
artworks.description: This painting shows a man seated on a throne-like chair in profile, facing left. He holds a scepter in one hand, and his other hand is draped over the armrest of the throne. The man has a light skin, a long, dark beard, and a sharp profile. He also has long, dark hair partly covered by a golden headdress with red fabric hanging from it. He wears a golden robe with draping blue sleeves. Jeweled rings are visible on each of his hands, and there's a golden earring in his ear in the shape of an arc. The throne he sits on is dark blue, and a dark blue curtain hangs behind it on the right. On the left, a distant landscape is visible beyond the throne, with blue-green trees under a white-and-blue sky.

artworks.title: Hôtel de Ville, Place des Terreaux, Lyons
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The drawing displays an elaborate and grand building facade. It depicts a detailed classical European building with ornate architecture, likely situated in an urban setting. The building features multiple stories, a symmetrical layout, columns, arched windows, sculptures adorning the roof line, a central tower with a dome, and a formal square or plaza. An inscription adds historical context to the piece.

artworks.title: Patriotic Fund
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash heightened with white on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical scene with mythological and classical elements. The central figure is seated, holding a trident, with a lion beside them. Two warriors in armor are battling a dragon-like creature in the clouds. Above them, two cherubs hover, one with a wreath and the other holding a banner with the word "PATRIOTIC" flanked by "F" and "S". The drawing is detailed and features soft hues.

artworks.title: Peter and His Children Visited by Three Flying Figures
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with gray wash over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: In the image, there are four people on the ground outside a small structure, looking up towards three flying figures. The group on the ground consists of an adult male, an older girl, and a younger girl. The man stands in the doorway, gazing up with curly hair and wearing a long-sleeved garment and trousers. The older girl raises her hand while looking up, wearing a short-sleeved dress with tied back hair. The younger girl peeks from behind with curly hair. There is a basket and a broom nearby. Above them, three nude figures with flowing hair and wing-like appendages soar, surrounded by trees in the background. The image has a sketch-like quality with shaded elements.

artworks.title: Design for a Book Illustration of Circe and Odysseus [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and gray and brown ink with gray wash over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: This drawing features various figures in different poses surrounding a central detailed scene. The central scene shows one seated and one standing figure. The surrounding sketches depict nude figures in dynamic poses, some upside down. The drawing captures the motion and dynamics of human anatomy.

artworks.title: Roger de Coverley and the Gypsies [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.description: The drawing features a collection of lightly sketched figures, including nude figures that are studies of the human form, positioned in various poses across the top portion of the paper. The bottom section shows historical or mythical characters, some wearing period clothing such as tricorn hats and long coats, suggesting an 18th-century setting. One figure appears to be in a military uniform, standing erect. The style of the sketch is loose and exploratory, with lines capturing the essence of human posture and interaction, reminiscent of preliminary studies or concepts for a larger work.

artworks.title: Sheet of Studies
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The drawing depicts various sketches of people in different poses and positions. The top left sketch shows an individual looking to the side, with a hat and distinct facial features, including a prominent nose and an open mouth. The person is shown with a hand raised. Adjacent sketches show heads and shoulders of other individuals in various positions. One person appears to have curly hair, while another has straight hair pulled back. The expressions are neutral, with detailed eyes and subtle mouths. Some figures exhibit facial profiles or angled views, emphasizing cheek and jaw contours. One person in the lower section appears to be leaning forward with a headband holding back curly hair, observing something below, possibly a woven basket. The attire suggests loose-fitting garments. The scene is sketched in sepia tones, with minimal background detailing, focusing more on the figures and their facial expressions and interactions. The background is plain and unadorned, accentuating the pencil or ink sketch work on the pale surface.

artworks.title: Vignette for a Title Page: "Winged Victory"
artworks.medium: pen and brown and black inks on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a winged figure holding a helmet adorned with a face. The artwork depicts a classical or mythological scene featuring an angelic or winged figure. The figure's wings are detailed with individual feathers, and it holds a helmet-like object. The contrast between the light figure and the dark circular background highlights the subject.
